question: Iron Mine: how does the cart change lanes at a junction?
options: The track switches by itself and an arrow on the ground shows the new direction
The player pulls a lever placed right beside the junction; the track change is subtle and there is no arrow
quote: lane change stays a player-pulled lever, subtle track change, no arrow

question: Storm Nest: how is the player warned that a gust is coming?
options: A text banner at the top of the screen announces the gust
Only a clear gust animation in the scene, no banner
quote: no banners; a clear gust animation is the cue

question: Storm Nest: what happens when a gust blows the hero off a walkway?
options: She loses HP and restarts the floor at its entrance
She drops to the floor below and must climb back
Game over, reload the last save
quote: Getting blown off a walkway drops the player to the floor below as the penalty

question: Shadow Cave: what happens to the shadow enemies while the crystals shine?
options: They vanish until the light fades
They freeze in place, stay visible, and bumping one still starts a battle
quote: shadows FREEZE in place (stay visible, bound), and bumping a frozen shadow still starts the battle

question: Desert Tomb: which core mechanic?
options: Pit traps the player must avoid
A glyph-order floor: the order is shown on a tablet in a separate entrance chamber, not visible from the plate room
A glyph-order floor with the order carved on the wall of the plate room itself
quote: no pit. Glyph-order floor ... The order must NOT be visible in the plate room

question: Desert Tomb: what happens on a wrong plate?
options: Instant damage to the hero
A battle with a specific guardian enemy, then a push back and the plates reset
Nothing, the plates just reset
quote: Wrong plate = battle with a specific enemy (Tomb Guardian), then push back + reset

question: Bandit Hideout: which trap design?
options: Timing traps: spikes that rise and fall on a rhythm the player must time
Nearly invisible tripwires that glint now and then, with a 'Cut trip wire' button when near; spikes hidden under a barely different floor patch
quote: not timing traps. Tripwires nearly invisible, glint periodically

question: Volcanic Forge: which mechanic?
options: Hammers and a crucible the player times
A windlass that lowers a drawbridge
Lava channels: turn trough tiles to route molten iron into a mold that cools into a bridge
quote: hammers/crucible and windlass drawbridge rejected. CHOSEN: lava channels

question: Stormreach Spire: which mechanic?
options: Wind that pushes the hero across the floor
Marked safe tiles plus a lightning rod item
The whole floor is struck in timed turns; stone glows before a strike and the player finds the safe path
quote: no wind, no marked tiles/rod. Whole floor area is struck in timed turns; stone glows before a strike ... Approved ('awesome')

question: Haunted Forest: which structure?
options: A lantern-lit maze on several levels joined by stairs
A simple single-level maze with no lights; rooms connect through gaps on the map edges with a sliding room-to-room transition
quote: no lanterns/lights; simple maze; single level, NO stairs

question: Frozen Lake: how much of the dungeon is ice sliding?
options: The whole dungeon is slide puzzles
One slippery ice room is the main feature that gates the stairs and key treasure, with ordinary paths and exploration around it
quote: a slippery ice room as the main feature ... plus ordinary paths/exploration

question: Order puzzles (Crystal Cave, Desert Tomb): hint for grades 1-2?
options: An always-visible order HUD
An optional hint HUD, collapsed by default
No hint at any grade
quote: Grades 1-2 get an optional hint HUD, collapsed by default

question: Save slots: how many per device? (the proposal recommended 3)
options: 3 slots
5 slots
1 slot plus an auto save
quote: 5 slots

question: What does one save slot hold?
options: One record; the newest save wins
Both the latest auto save and the last manual save; the player picks which to load
quote: each slot keeps BOTH auto save and last manual save, player picks which to load

question: Defeat penalty?
options: No penalty, reload where you were
Wake in the last town with full HP, keep everything, lose half your gold
Lose all gold
Reload the last manual save, losing progress since
quote: defeat = last town, full HP, keep all, lose half gold

question: Boss retry: what state does the player restart the fight in? (the proposal recommended full HP)
options: Full HP and no gold loss
HP and items exactly as they were when the fight began
quote: boss retry restores HP/items exactly as at fight start (option 5B, not full heal)

question: Dungeon crystals: what do they do?
options: Save, heal and warp
Heal and warp, no save (saving is automatic at checkpoints and manual only in towns)
quote: crystals heal+warp, no save

question: Ship scope for the public release?
options: All five acts with the new rebuilt worlds
Act 1 first, later acts as updates
All acts now, keeping the old Acts 2-5 layouts
quote: all five acts with the new worlds (option A)

question: Overworld scrolling test on device: which mode?
options: A: step scrolling in whole game pixels
B: fine sub-pixel scrolling
quote: scrolling 'probably A'

question: Male hero's right-facing walk frames are drawn too small. Fix by?
options: Mirroring the left-facing frames
Enlarging the existing frames 1.227x
Redrawing the frames properly (image generation on the Mac)
quote: Chris chose option 3 (redraw on the Mac)

question: First ending screen mockup (title, hero, several stat sections, messages, buttons): verdict?
options: Approve it
Reject as too cluttered; simplify
quote: better but way too cluttered

question: Ending screen layout?
options: A: one simple screen: title, hero, one line, small results line, two buttons
B: two steps: a celebration screen, then a results screen
quote: Chris chose ending layout A

question: The simple ending screen is built in a plain style. Verdict?
options: Good as it is
Content is right but it must look more grand and congratulatory
quote: layout A content is right but the design must be more grand and congratulatory

question: Bugs that exist only in the old Acts 2-5 dungeon layouts, now that those dungeons are being rebuilt?
options: Fix them anyway
Forget them; the old dungeons are only a springboard
quote: totally forget about the old dungeon; it can be a springboard but this version is a rebuild

question: New Game+ after clearing the game: where can it be started?
options: Only from the ending screen
From the ending screen and also later from the cleared slot on the save data screen
quote: asked that NG+ also be selectable later from the save data screen

question: Void Rift: how does the hero cross the drifting blocks?
options: She jumps between blocks with a jump button
Square blocks touch as they pass; she simply walks across, no jump
quote: square blocks that touch when passing; walk across, no jump

question: Coastal Reef: is shallow water walkable at low tide?
options: Yes, shallow water can be waded
No. Water is never walkable; the rising tide blocks the way and nudges the hero back
quote: water never walkable; rising tide blocks and nudges hero back

question: Whispering Woods: what starts the firefly glow that shows the way?
options: The player steps on a switch
Nothing: it pulses from the cave middle to the stairs on a fixed beat
quote: firefly glow pulses from the cave middle to the stairs on a fixed beat, no trigger

question: Scorched Ruins: how visible are the secret walls?
options: Clearly marked with an obvious crack and sparkle
A faint crack plus a small hint
No visual sign at all
quote: secrets neither too hard nor too obvious (faint crack + small hint)

question: Storm Nest floors: which layout?
options: Walled corridors with windows
Mostly wide walkways over gaps, few walls, paths about 3 tiles wide
quote: Floors are mostly wide walkways over gaps (few walls) ... Paths ~3 tiles wide (touch joystick)
